description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling payment-related operations, including creating checkout sessions, webhook handling, and retrieving payment histories. It contains multiple API endpoints, data models with Pydantic, and stub implementations for payment provider integrations, notably Stripe. The code manages environment-based behavior to simulate or facilitate real payment processing and includes administrative and user-facing routes.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutRequest
classes.description: Request schema for creating a payment checkout session, including amount, currency, and optional reference.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutResponse
classes.description: Response schema detailing the provider info, session IDs, payment ID, status, and message.

classes.name: PaymentItem
classes.description: Data model representing a payment record for listing purposes.

classes.name: PaymentsListResponse
classes.description: Response wrapper for paginated list of payment items with total count.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_provider_keys()
methods.description: Retrieves Stripe provider secret and webhook keys from environment variables.

methods.name: PaymentItem _to_item(p: Payments)
methods.description: Converts a Payments ORM object to a PaymentItem data model.

methods.name: CreateCheckoutResponse create_checkout( payload: CreateCheckoutRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a payment intent or checkout session stub, inserting a payment record and returning provider placeholders.

methods.name: dict stripe_webhook( request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db), stripe_signature: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Stripe-Signature"), )
methods.description: Handles webhook callbacks from Stripe, updating payment status based on event type.

methods.name: PaymentsListResponse payment_history( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of the current user's payment records.

methods.name: PaymentsListResponse admin_payments( db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by status (pending/success/failed/refunded)"), user_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by specific user"), )
methods.description: Provides an administrative view of payments, viewable by users with admin roles, with optional filtering.
